acceptance.given: A toolchain behavior path is evaluated on a supported platform where behavior may differ by platform.

oracle.expected: The toolchain artifact explicitly declares the platform-specific behavior and its applicable platform context.
oracle.observable: The replay or evaluation artifact contains an explicit platform-behavior declaration.

acceptance.then: The resulting toolchain metadata includes a platform-specific behavior declaration.
acceptance.when: The platform-differing behavior path is inspected during replay/evaluation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Inspect a platform-differing behavior path whose evaluation artifact omits the required platform declaration and observe contract rejection.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Declare platform-specific toolchain behavior in the replay/evaluation artifact whenever behavior differs by platform.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay inputs and artifact schema; revert only platform-declaration enforcement.

slice_hint.state_transition: Platform-differing behavior changes from undeclared metadata to an explicit platform declaration in the toolchain artifact.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The inspected artifact contains a non-empty declaration identifying the platform-specific behavior and platform context.

acceptance.given: A replay result is produced from repository-relative pinned inputs.

oracle.expected: The replay result is associated with a Current Snapshot containing the Git baseline, Skill-input v2 selection and content, and all result-determining code, fixtures, contracts, Consumers, tests, targets, validators, dependencies, sources, and evidence.
forbidden: A replay result unbound from a Current Snapshot.
A replay result bound to an incomplete or partial Current Snapshot.
oracle.observable: Serialized replay result and its typed Current Snapshot binding

acceptance.then: The replay result is associated with a complete Current Snapshot.
acceptance.when: The Toolchain replay implementation emits a replay result.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Produce a replay result with a missing, partial, or unbound Current Snapshot and require fail-closed evaluation.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Bind every emitted replay result to a complete typed Current Snapshot of all result-determining inputs and fail closed when that binding is absent or incomplete.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Existing replay result consumers retain compatibility; incomplete snapshot bindings become stale or fail-closed rather than successful.

slice_hint.state_transition: replay inputs selected -> complete Current Snapshot bound -> replay result emitted; incomplete binding -> non-success
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Each produced replay result has a complete Current Snapshot association covering every result-determining input, and partial or missing bindings cannot produce success.

acceptance.given: An invalid-package adversarial case is supplied to the Toolchain success evaluator.

oracle.expected: Evaluation returns a non-success outcome for the invalid-package case.
forbidden: The invalid-package case is classified as success.
A stale or unrelated receipt is used instead of executing the invalid-package evaluation.
oracle.observable: The evaluator's current result contains a non-success verdict tied to the invalid-package input.

acceptance.then: The invalid-package case is rejected as success and produces a current non-success verdict.
acceptance.when: When an invalid-package case is evaluated by the Toolchain replay/evaluation path.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure invalid-package inputs cannot yield a success verdict; emit a current non-success evaluation result.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep existing replay result schema and verdict compatibility; revert only invalid-package success handling and its S24 test.

slice_hint.state_transition: Invalid-package evaluation moves from success-accepted to explicit non-success rejection.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A live invalid-package evaluation produces non-success and the success path is not taken.

acceptance.given: The Atomic Obligation graph and its runtime-evidence nodes are available to the Exact Cover validator.

oracle.expected: Exact-cover validation reports a forward relation from every Atomic Obligation to runtime evidence and a reverse relation from every runtime-evidence node to its covered Atomic Obligation, with no orphan on either side.
forbidden: An Atomic Obligation covered by runtime evidence without reverse coverage.
A runtime-evidence node linked without corresponding Atomic Obligation coverage.
oracle.observable: Bidirectional Exact Cover validation report for Atomic Obligation-to-runtime-evidence edges

acceptance.then: Every Atomic Obligation and runtime-evidence relation is mutually and exactly covered.
acceptance.when: The Toolchain compiles the obligation graph or runs Exact Cover validation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Validate an orphaned or one-directional Atomic Obligation-to-runtime-evidence edge and require the structural Exact Cover check to fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate both forward and reverse Exact Cover edges between every Atomic Obligation and its runtime-evidence nodes, rejecting orphaned or one-directional links.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: The Exact Cover graph remains bidirectional; malformed runtime-evidence mappings are rejected without redefining existing obligation identities.

slice_hint.state_transition: obligation graph compiled -> forward and reverse runtime-evidence edges evaluated -> exact-cover report or structural failure
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The Exact Cover validator confirms both directions for every Atomic Obligation-to-runtime-evidence relationship and reports no orphaned node.
